caption: Results of our model with different weights of negative samples.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the normalized PMI (NPMI) value as a function of the weight of negative sampling for four different models: MI, IMDB, NIPS, and 20NG. The x-axis, labeled “weight of negative sampling,” ranges from 0.5 to 3.5, using a linear scale with tick intervals of 0.5. The y-axis, labeled “NPMI,” ranges from approximately 0.18 to 0.42, using a logarithmic scale with tick intervals of 0.02. A black solid line represents the MI model, initiating at a value of approximately 0.38 and decreasing to 0.32 by the end of the x-axis. A red solid line depicts the IMDB model, starting at approximately 0.20 and increasing to 0.40 at x=1.0, then decreasing back to approximately 0.20 by the end of the x-axis. A blue solid line represents the NIPS model, beginning at around 0.38 and reducing to 0.36 by the end of the x-axis. Finally, a dark blue solid line shows the 20NG model, which starts at approximately 0.38, declines to nearly 0.36 at the end of the x-axis.
